content:
We're pleased to invite you to the next installment in our series of ongoing Bytecode Alliance Plumbers Summits, to be held Wednesday October 28, 2026. This will be an all on-line event supporting full remote participation for anyone anywhere, in three-hour sessions each day that will be recorded so they can be viewed anytime afterward via our YouTube channel.  Watch this topic for more information leading up to the event and as a live conversation during the event itself.

Thank you for your support of the Alliance, our projects, and our community!  We hope you’ll join us for our next Plumbers Summit!

The planned agenda for the event is now available via our general meeting information repository here. Additional details will be provided both there and here to help you plan for and attend the event.

All times are US Pacific Daylight (GMT-7):

  • Welcome - Oscar Spencer
  • 8:00 - 8:45 - Luke Wagner – “Component Model Update”
  • 8:45 - 8:50 - Quick break
  • 8:50 - 9:20 - Chris Fallin – “Debugging”
  • 9:20 - 9:40 - Alex Crichton – “Toolchains and Cooperative Threads”
  • 9:40 - 10:00 - Joel Dice – “Guest Languages Update”
  • 10:00 - 10:20 - Till Schneidereit – “StarlingMonkey Next”
  • 10:20 - 10:30 - Quick break
  • 10:30 - 11:15 - “Collaborating in the Age of AI” (Till & Oscar, facilitating)
  • 11:15 - 12:00 - Lunch and hallway conversations (with Zoom breakout rooms)
  • 12:00 - 1:00 - Games
  • Wrap-up and Thanks - Oscar Spencer
